feature_spec.normalization: Unicode NFKC, Unicode lowercase, collapse whitespace with single ASCII spaces
feature_spec.words: Unicode letter-or-digit runs; word unigrams and bigrams joined by U+001F, prefixes w:
feature_spec.characters: pad normalized text with one ASCII space each side; character 3/4/5-grams, prefixes c3:/c4:/c5:
feature_spec.hash: 32-bit unsigned FNV-1a over UTF-8; index = hash modulo dimensions

training.dataset: ClaimBuster Spotter two_class official train/test split
limitations: Political debate sentences, not WhatsApp forwards or phone-user validation.
English supervised data only; Hindi behavior is limited to explicit runtime guards and cues.
Predicts check-worthiness, never truth, falsity, harm, or source reliability.
